- graphify: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

57	// safeDialContext is a net.Dialer.DialContext replacement that resolves the target
58	// hostname and rejects any address that falls within a reserved/private IP range.
59	func safeDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
60		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: invalid address %q", addr)
63		}
64	
65		ips, err := net.DefaultResolver.LookupHost(ctx, host)
66		if err != nil {
67			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "webhook: failed to resolve host %q", host)
68		}
69	
70		for _, ipStr := range ips {
71			if ip := net.ParseIP(ipStr); ip != nil && isReservedIP(ip) {
72				return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: connection to reserved/private IP address is not allowed")
73			}
74		}
75	
76		return (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
77	}

92	// resolveSigningKey returns the raw HMAC key for a signing secret. Secrets using
93	// the Standard Webhooks "whsec_<base64>" serialization are base64-decoded to their
94	// raw bytes; any other secret is used as-is. It returns an error when a whsec_-prefixed
95	// secret is not valid base64, so callers fail loudly instead of silently signing with
96	// the wrong key (which would make every signature unverifiable by the receiver).
97	func resolveSigningKey(secret string) ([]byte, error) {
98		if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(secret, "whsec_"); ok {
99			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(rest)
100			if err != nil {
101				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "signing secret has whsec_ prefix but is not valid base64")
102			}
103			return decoded, nil
104		}
105		return []byte(secret), nil
106	}

108	// GenerateSigningSecret returns a new Standard Webhooks signing secret in the
109	// "whsec_<base64>" form, backed by 32 cryptographically-random bytes — comfortably
110	// within the spec's 24–64 byte range.
111	func GenerateSigningSecret() (string, error) {
112		buf := make([]byte, 32)
113		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
114			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read random bytes for signing secret")
115		}
116		return "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil
117	}

119	// Post posts the message to webhook endpoint.
120	func Post(requestPayload *WebhookRequestPayload) error {
121		body, err := json.Marshal(requestPayload)
122		if err != nil {
123			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to marshal webhook request to %s", requestPayload.URL)
124		}
125	
126		req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", requestPayload.URL, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
127		if err != nil {
128			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to construct webhook request to %s", requestPayload.URL)
129		}
130	
131		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
132	
133		if requestPayload.SigningSecret != "" {
134			key, err := resolveSigningKey(requestPayload.SigningSecret)
135			if err != nil {
136				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to derive signing key for webhook to %s", requestPayload.URL)
137			}
138	
139			msgID := "msg_" + uuid.New().String()
140			timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10)
141	
142			mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
143			mac.Write([]byte(msgID + "." + timestamp + "."))
144			mac.Write(body)
145			signature := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
146	
147			req.Header.Set("webhook-id", msgID)
148			req.Header.Set("webhook-timestamp", timestamp)
149			req.Header.Set("webhook-signature", "v1,"+signature)
150		}
151	
152		resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)
153		if err != nil {
154			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to post webhook to %s", requestPayload.URL)
155		}
156		defer resp.Body.Close()
157	
158		b, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20))
159		if err != nil {
160			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to read webhook response from %s", requestPayload.URL)
161		}
162	
163		if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode > 299 {
164			return errors.Errorf("failed to post webhook %s, status code: %d", requestPayload.URL, resp.StatusCode)
165		}
166	
167		response := &struct {
168			Code    int    `json:"code"`
169			Message string `json:"message"`
170		}{}
171		if err := json.Unmarshal(b, response); err != nil {
172			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to unmarshal webhook response from %s", requestPayload.URL)
173		}
174	
175		if response.Code != 0 {
176			return errors.Errorf("receive error code sent by webhook server, code %d, msg: %s", response.Code, response.Message)
177		}
178	
179		return nil
180	}

142

170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err
172					}
173					updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
174				default:
175					// Ignore unsupported fields
176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
181				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
182				if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
183					return nil, err
184				}
185				updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
186			}

188			if request.Webhook.SigningSecret != "" {

190				if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
191					return nil, err
192				}
193				updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
194			}
195		}

197		err = s.Store.UpdateUserWebhook(ctx, userID, updatedWebhook)

200		}

31	func newHTTPClient() *http.Client {
32		transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()

51	func secureDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
52		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "invalid address")
55		}
56	
57		ips, err := resolveAllowedIPs(ctx, host)
58		if err != nil {

60		}

62		var dialErr error
63		for _, ip := range ips {
64			conn, err := dialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(ip.String(), port))
65			if err == nil {
66				return conn, nil
67			}
68			dialErr = err
69		}
70		return nil, dialErr

73	func resolveAllowedIPs(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]net.IP, error) {

26	// NewIdentityProvider initializes a new OAuth2 Identity Provider with the given configuration.
27	func NewIdentityProvider(config *storepb.OAuth2Config) (*IdentityProvider, error) {
28		for v, field := range map[string]string{
29			config.ClientId:                "clientId",
30			config.ClientSecret:            "clientSecret",
31			config.TokenUrl:                "tokenUrl",
32			config.UserInfoUrl:             "userInfoUrl",

45	// ExchangeToken returns the exchanged OAuth2 token using the given authorization code.
46	// If codeVerifier is provided, it will be used for PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) validation.
47	func (p *IdentityProvider) ExchangeToken(ctx context.Context, redirectURL, code, codeVerifier string) (string, error) {
48		conf := &oauth2.Config{
49			ClientID:     p.config.ClientId,
50			ClientSecret: p.config.ClientSecret,
51			RedirectURL:  redirectURL,
52			Scopes:       p.config.Scopes,
53			Endpoint: oauth2.Endpoint{
54				AuthURL:   p.config.AuthUrl,
55				TokenURL:  p.config.TokenUrl,
56				AuthStyle: oauth2.AuthStyleAutoDetect,
57			},
58		}
59	
60		// Prepare token exchange options
61		opts := []oauth2.AuthCodeOption{}
62	
63		// Add PKCE code_verifier if provided
64		if codeVerifier != "" {
65			opts = append(opts, oauth2.SetAuthURLParam("code_verifier", codeVerifier))
66		}
67	
68		token, err := conf.Exchange(ctx, code, opts...)
69		if err != nil {
70			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to exchange access token")
71		}
72	
73		// Use the standard AccessToken field instead of Extra()
74		// This is more reliable across different OAuth providers
75		if token.AccessToken == "" {
76			return "", errors.New("missing access token from authorization response")
77		}
78	
79		return token.AccessToken, nil
80	}

94		}

98			body, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 4096))

18	// invariant of the signing-secret feature: the secret is INPUT_ONLY and must never

20	func TestConvertUserWebhookFromUserSettingOmitsSigningSecret(t *testing.T) {

40	func TestUserWebhookSigningSecretLifecycle(t *testing.T) {

47		owner, err := svc.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{Username: "owner", Role: store.RoleUser, Email: "owner@example.com"})

86	// TestPostSignsRequest verifies the end-to-end Standard Webhooks signature so a
87	// receiver following the documented verification recipe will accept our requests.
88	func TestPostSignsRequest(t *testing.T) {
89		// httptest listens on 127.0.0.1, which the SSRF guard blocks by default.
90		prev := AllowPrivateIPs
91		AllowPrivateIPs = true
92		defer func() { AllowPrivateIPs = prev }()
93	
94		rawKey := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
95		cases := []struct {
96			name   string
97			secret string
98			key    []byte
99		}{
100			{name: "plain secret", secret: "plain-secret-value", key: []byte("plain-secret-value")},
101			{name: "whsec_ secret", secret: "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey), key: rawKey},
102		}
103	
104		for _, tc := range cases {
105			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
106				var gotID, gotTimestamp, gotSignature string
107				var gotBody []byte
108				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
109					gotID = r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
110					gotTimestamp = r.Header.Get("webhook-timestamp")
111					gotSignature = r.Header.Get("webhook-signature")
112					gotBody, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
113					_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
114				}))
115				defer server.Close()
116	
117				err := Post(&WebhookRequestPayload{
118					URL:           server.URL,
119					ActivityType:  "memos.memo.created",
120					Creator:       "users/1",
121					SigningSecret: tc.secret,
122				})
123				require.NoError(t, err)
124	
125				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotID, "msg_"), "webhook-id should be prefixed with msg_")
126				require.NotEmpty(t, gotTimestamp)
127				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotSignature, "v1,"), "signature should carry the v1 version tag")
128	
129				// Recompute the signature the way a receiver would and confirm it matches.
130				mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, tc.key)
131				mac.Write([]byte(gotID + "." + gotTimestamp + "."))
132				mac.Write(gotBody)
133				want := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
134				require.Equal(t, "v1,"+want, gotSignature)
135			})
136		}
137	}

18	var ErrInternalIP = errors.New("internal IP addresses are not allowed")
19	
20	const maxHTMLMetaBytes = 512 * 1024
21	
22	var (
23		lookupIPAddr = net.DefaultResolver.LookupIPAddr
24		dialContext  = (&net.Dialer{
25			Timeout:   30 * time.Second,
26			KeepAlive: 30 * time.Second,
27		}).DialContext
28		httpClient = newHTTPClient()

31	func newHTTPClient() *http.Client {
32		transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
33		transport.Proxy = nil
34		transport.DialContext = secureDialContext
35	
36		return &http.Client{
37			Transport: transport,
38			Timeout:   5 * time.Second,
39			CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
40				if err := validateURL(req.URL.String()); err != nil {
41					return errors.Wrap(err, "redirect to internal IP")
42				}
43				if len(via) >= 10 {
44					return errors.New("too many redirects")
45				}
46				return nil
47			},
48		}
49	}

51	func secureDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
52		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "invalid address")
55		}
56	
57		ips, err := resolveAllowedIPs(ctx, host)
58		if err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}
61	
62		var dialErr error
63		for _, ip := range ips {
64			conn, err := dialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(ip.String(), port))
65			if err == nil {
66				return conn, nil
67			}
68			dialErr = err
69		}
70		return nil, dialErr
71	}

73	func resolveAllowedIPs(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]net.IP, error) {
74		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil {
75			if isInternalIP(ip) {
76				return nil, errors.Wrap(ErrInternalIP, ip.String())
77			}
78			return []net.IP{ip}, nil
79		}
80	
81		addrs, err := lookupIPAddr(ctx, host)
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, errors.Errorf("failed to resolve hostname: %v", err)
84		}
85	
86		ips := make([]net.IP, 0, len(addrs))
87		for _, addr := range addrs {
88			ip := addr.IP
89			if ip == nil {
90				continue
91			}
92			if isInternalIP(ip) {
93				return nil, errors.Wrapf(ErrInternalIP, "host=%s, ip=%s", host, ip.String())
94			}
95			ips = append(ips, ip)
96		}
97		if len(ips) == 0 {
98			return nil, errors.New("hostname resolved to no addresses")
99		}
100	
101		return ips, nil
102	}

104	func isInternalIP(ip net.IP) bool {
105		return ip.IsLoopback() || ip.IsPrivate() || ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast() || ip.IsUnspecified()
106	}

108	func validateURL(urlStr string) error {
109		u, err := url.Parse(urlStr)
110		if err != nil {
111			return errors.New("invalid URL format")
112		}
113	
114		if u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https" {
115			return errors.New("only http/https protocols are allowed")
116		}
117	
118		host := u.Hostname()
119		if host == "" {
120			return errors.New("empty hostname")
121		}
122	
123		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && isInternalIP(ip) {
124			return errors.Wrap(ErrInternalIP, ip.String())
125		}
126	
127		return nil
128	}

130	type HTMLMeta struct {
131		Title       string `json:"title"`
132		Description string `json:"description"`
133		Image       string `json:"image"`
134	}
135	
136	func GetHTMLMeta(urlStr string) (*HTMLMeta, error) {
137		if err := validateURL(urlStr); err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140	
141		response, err := httpClient.Get(urlStr)
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, err
144		}
145		defer response.Body.Close()
146	
147		mediatype, err := getMediatype(response)
148		if err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if mediatype != "text/html" {
152			return nil, errors.New("not a HTML page")
153		}
154	
155		htmlMeta := extractHTMLMeta(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maxHTMLMetaBytes))
156		enrichSiteMeta(response.Request.URL, htmlMeta)
157		return htmlMeta, nil
158	}

160	func extractHTMLMeta(resp io.Reader) *HTMLMeta {
161		tokenizer := html.NewTokenizer(resp)
162		htmlMeta := new(HTMLMeta)
163	
164		for {
165			tokenType := tokenizer.Next()
166			if tokenType == html.ErrorToken {
167				break
168			} else if tokenType == html.StartTagToken || tokenType == html.SelfClosingTagToken {
169				token := tokenizer.Token()
170				if token.DataAtom == atom.Body {
171					break
172				}
173	
174				if token.DataAtom == atom.Title {
175					tokenizer.Next()
176					token := tokenizer.Token()
177					htmlMeta.Title = token.Data
178				} else if token.DataAtom == atom.Meta {
179					ogTitle, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:title")
180					if ok {
181						htmlMeta.Title = ogTitle
182					}
183	
184					ogDescription, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:description")
185					if ok {
186						htmlMeta.Description = ogDescription
187					}
188	
189					ogImage, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "og:image")
190					if ok {
191						htmlMeta.Image = ogImage
192					}
193	
194					description, ok := extractMetaProperty(token, "description")
195					if ok && htmlMeta.Description == "" {
196						htmlMeta.Description = description
197					}
198				}
199			}
200		}
201	
202		return htmlMeta
203	}

205	func extractMetaProperty(token html.Token, prop string) (content string, ok bool) {
206		content, ok = "", false
207		for _, attr := range token.Attr {
208			if (attr.Key == "property" || attr.Key == "name") && strings.EqualFold(attr.Val, prop) {
209				ok = true
210			}
211			if attr.Key == "content" {
212				content = attr.Val
213			}
214		}
215		return content, ok
216	}

218	func enrichSiteMeta(url *url.URL, meta *HTMLMeta) {
219		if url.Hostname() == "www.youtube.com" {

222				if vid != "" {

26	// NewIdentityProvider initializes a new OAuth2 Identity Provider with the given configuration.
27	func NewIdentityProvider(config *storepb.OAuth2Config) (*IdentityProvider, error) {
28		for v, field := range map[string]string{
29			config.ClientId:                "clientId",
30			config.ClientSecret:            "clientSecret",
31			config.TokenUrl:                "tokenUrl",

45	// ExchangeToken returns the exchanged OAuth2 token using the given authorization code.
46	// If codeVerifier is provided, it will be used for PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) validation.
47	func (p *IdentityProvider) ExchangeToken(ctx context.Context, redirectURL, code, codeVerifier string) (string, error) {
48		conf := &oauth2.Config{
49			ClientID:     p.config.ClientId,
50			ClientSecret: p.config.ClientSecret,
51			RedirectURL:  redirectURL,
52			Scopes:       p.config.Scopes,
53			Endpoint: oauth2.Endpoint{
54				AuthURL:   p.config.AuthUrl,
55				TokenURL:  p.config.TokenUrl,
56				AuthStyle: oauth2.AuthStyleAutoDetect,

60		// Prepare token exchange options

64		if codeVerifier != "" {
65			opts = append(opts, oauth2.SetAuthURLParam("code_verifier", codeVerifier))
66		}
67	
68		token, err := conf.Exchange(ctx, code, opts...)
69		if err != nil {
70			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to exchange access token")
71		}
72	
73		// Use the standard AccessToken field instead of Extra()
74		// This is more reliable across different OAuth providers
75		if token.AccessToken == "" {
76			return "", errors.New("missing access token from authorization response")
77		}
78	
79		return token.AccessToken, nil
